views.rationale: Services net sales rose 12% to $19.6 bn, driving total sales growth.
Operating margin improved to -3.9% for the quarter versus -7.8% a year earlier, with revenues up $204 m.
BANA settled penalties of $125 m and $100 m, indicating a potential drag on earnings.
Total upstream earnings jumped 169% to $8.6 bn and net income rose 277% to $11.6 bn.
repurchases of Class A and Class C shares were $15.2 billion for the three months ended June 30 2022
Technology, Media & Telecommunications exposure accounted for 20% of loans and 21% of lending commitments
worldwide sales were $47.4 billion, a total increase of 4.0% for the fiscal six months of 2022
